increment_paragraph: **CONTRIBUTION-LEDGERS (pluggable-cards seam A, phase P2; measure plugin and Python tooling only, no analyzer, contract, Lean or verdict change).** A rule's contribution to a live evaluation profile is now a checked record ([report](../../reports/contribution-ledgers/README.md)). New scripts/contribution_ledgers.py owns quirin-contribution-ledger/1: rows moved with the named premises their TIP rows rest on, leaves traded, touched rows that stay Unknown and why, measured from one binary as TIP against TIP-with-rules-off, with the binary digest, the committed native-comparison record's digest and the profile baseline digest; ledgers live at contract/contributions/<rule-id>/<profile>.json and contract/contributions/interactions/<id>+<id>/<profile>.json, which gate_scope.py classifies as Python-checked records. quirin-audit measure --rules-off IDS fills its contribution slot (ledger.rs); --per-rule adds one single-rule-off side per id, and a row is a rule's only when that switch alone moves it and the joint switch moves it the same way, every other moved row being a named interaction ledger, never attributed to one rule; a group whose base plus deltas misses the TIP totals fails the run. contribution_ledgers.py write copies a committed record's ledgers into the tree only when the TIP figures are the profile's baseline figures; check verifies layout, schema, record digest, slot entry, rule ids (registry.toml once it exists, else a rule document with a router row), live profile and complete groups; consistency requires every current group to re-derive its profile's real-run total as base plus ordered contributions plus named interactions, reports and fails a disagreement or a row shared by two current measurements, never repairs it, and lists groups measured on an older baseline as stale. The generated docs/development/contributions.md renders lines such as 'rule 33: one row under one premise' beside each live profile's total under a committed-equals-generated test, and land.py adds its render to the landing sequence. apply_amendments.py narrows contribution to null or {"ledgers": [...]} and applies it (checks, consistency, page regeneration); no committed document used the reserved field. The pilot rules' report deltas are not transcribed; each pilot's migration card measures its ledger by switch. Every ledger in the card's tests comes from synthetic switched runs, because no binary advertises QCORE_GATEWAY_RULES_OFF yet. GATE_SUMMARY
status_paragraph: Per-rule contribution ledgers (card CONTRIBUTION-LEDGERS) are rendered beside each live evaluation profile's real-run total in [contributions](development/contributions.md), generated by scripts/contribution_ledgers.py from contract/contributions/ with a consistency check that never repairs a total; no ledger is recorded yet, since no analyzer binary advertises the rule switch.

ledger.why: DISCHARGE (CONTRIBUTION-LEDGERS; the profiles half was RECORDS-TOOLING's): apply_amendments.py narrows contribution to null or {"ledgers": [path, ...]} and applies it through contribution_ledgers.check_contribution (each ledger exists, validates, matches its native-comparison record's digest and slot entry, names known rule ids, is on a live profile, its measurement's other ledgers are listed and the group adds up; the tree passes consistency; a stale ledger is noted) and regenerates docs/development/contributions.md; no committed document used the reserved field, so no schema bump. Tests: scripts/tests/test_apply_amendments.py ContributionTests and REFUSALS, scripts/tests/test_contribution_ledgers.py Contribution.

ledger.text: CONTRIBUTION-LEDGERS (2026-10-26) fills the slot: it holds quirin-contribution-ledger/1 ledgers built from the <tip>-off -> <tip> comparison (and with --per-rule from one <tip>-off-<id> side per rule, rows moved by two rules together named as interaction ledgers), checked by scripts/contribution_ledgers.py; exercised only with stub analyzers that honour the switch. The discharge still needs one real --rules-off measurement on a migrated rule, written with contribution_ledgers.py write and passing consistency.

ledger.title: Bind contribution ledgers to the gateway rule registry once it lands
ledger.text: scripts/contribution_ledgers.py (card CONTRIBUTION-LEDGERS) refuses a ledger for a rule absent from crates/gateway-rules/registry.toml once that file exists, reading any TOML table with a string `id` in file order for existence and for the order of contributions; until then it checks docs/agents/rules/<id>.md. GATEWAY-RULE-API had not landed, so the reader is generic and untested against a real registry. DISCHARGE: when the registry lands, its rows carry `id` equal to the rule-document id in consultation order (or registry_ids reads the API's actual field), a test reads the real registry, and each registry row may reference its contract/contributions/<id>/ directory.

ledger.title: Measure rules 32/32a's contribution ledgers by switch
ledger.text: Rule 32's report (docs/reports/w48-rk-log-caller-frame/README.md) records 7 eight-home rows Unknown to Safe under three named premises, separated from rules 34 and 35 by compile-time builds, not by a run-time switch; CONTRIBUTION-LEDGERS did not transcribe it (source report-transcribed is not accepted). DISCHARGE: after rule 32a's migration card, quirin-audit measure --profile eight-home (and the other live profiles) --rules-off 32a (with --per-rule beside any rule it interacts with) writes the ledgers with contribution_ledgers.py write, consistency passes, and the report compares the measured rows and premises with the recorded 7.
